scopeReview: CED CHA-5.B.2–3: triangular, semicircular and geometrically specified cross sections. Distinguish legs/hypotenuse, side/altitude, radius/diameter, full versus half circles and incomplete geometric information. The circular funnel is an explicit allowed known-section example. No BC methods.
varietyReview: Equilateral-side polynomial, semicircle-diameter triangle base, right-isosceles leg power, circular-base hypotenuse, fixed triangle altitude, equilateral altitude, actual piecewise diameter graph, transformed-area nonuniform table, cross-shape volume ratio, circular funnel and insufficient right-triangle geometry. Nine original-area/graph/table corroborations plus two exact geometric reviews.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
